other_failure_modes.name: Missing validation labels and shape mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: During cross-validation, the agent fails to extract validation labels and creates a LightGBM validation Dataset without labels. It then incorrectly attempts to compute the MSE between the validation predictions and the training labels, which will result in a shape mismatch error and crash the execution.

other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test data with test statistics
other_failure_modes.description: The missing values in the test set are imputed using the median of the test set rather than the median of the training set. This is a bad practice (transductive imputation) that assumes access to the global test distribution and breaks when predicting on individual instances in production.

summary: The solution implements a basic LightGBM regression model with 5-fold cross-validation. However, it is fatally flawed by critical execution bugs: it evaluates validation predictions against training labels (causing a shape mismatch), creates validation datasets without labels, and uses early stopping in the final training run without providing a validation set. Furthermore, it improperly imputes test data using test statistics and completely skips feature engineering.
